title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models repeatedly apply a weight-shared block to increase effective depth without increasing parameter count, but the resulting T sequential recurrent-block calls per generated token substantially increase decoding latency. To address the issue, we introduce Wavefront Decoding (WFD), a training-free self-speculative decoding framework designed for looped language models. WFD exploits two properties of these architectures: intermediate recurrence outputs provide effective draft predictions, and weight sharing allows token states at different positions and recurrence depths to be processed in one batched recurrent-block call. WFD organizes these mixed-depth states into a diagonal wavefront, continuously drafting new positions at shallow depth while advancing earlier positions toward full-depth verification. translated_title: 波前解码：面向循环语言模型的并行化自推测解码
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过重复应用权重共享的模块来增加有效深度而不增加参数量，但由此导致每生成一个token需要T次顺序的循环模块调用，显著增加了解码延迟。为解决这一问题，我们提出了波前解码，这是一种专为循环语言模型设计的无需训练的自推测解码框架。WFD利用了这类架构的两个特性：中间循环输出可以提供有效的草稿预测，且权重共享使得不同位置和不同循环深度的token状态可以在一次批量循环模块调用中处理。WFD将这些混合深度的状态组织成对角波前，在浅层深度持续为新位置生成草稿，同时推进较早位置向全深度验证前进。与相位分离的“先草稿后验证”调度不同，WFD因此将草稿生成与验证共同批处理在同一循环模块调用中。
tldr: 波前解码（WFD）是一种无需训练的自推测解码框架，它将不同循环深度的token状态组织成对角波前，在同一次批量循环模块调用中共同批处理草稿生成与验证，从而显著降低循环语言模型的解码延迟。
en_tdlr: WaveFront Decoding (WFD) is a training-free self-speculative decoding framework that organizes mixed-depth token states into a diagonal wavefront and co-batches drafting and verification within a single batched recurrent-block call, substantially reducing decoding latency for looped language models.
